from icalendar import Calendar, Event, Alarm
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

cal = Calendar()
cal.add('prodid', '-//Cuga Agent//EN')
cal.add('version', '2.0')
cal.add('calscale', 'GREGORIAN')
cal.add('method', 'PUBLISH')

event = Event()
event.add('summary', 'Project Kickoff Meeting')
event.add('dtstart', datetime(2024, 7, 10, 14, 0, 0))
event.add('dtend', datetime(2024, 7, 10, 15, 0, 0))
event.add('location', 'Conference Room A')
event.add('description', 'Initial meeting to discuss project scope and deliverables.')
event.add('dtstamp', datetime(2024, 7, 10, 0, 0, 0))

alarm = Alarm()
alarm.add('action', 'DISPLAY')
alarm.add('description', 'Reminder: Project Kickoff Meeting in 15 minutes')
alarm.add('trigger', timedelta(minutes=-15))
event.add_component(alarm)

cal.add_component(event)

with open('output/Project_Kickoff_Meeting.ics', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(cal.to_ical())

print('ICS file created successfully.')
'''
